title: Grid-forming inverter
description: Voltage-source converter with synthetic inertia (virtual synchronous machine): ride-through, impedance-scan and RMS-model parameters. Omitted for want of a unit: the RMS VoltageGain (pu EMF per pu error per s; record default 2.0): NOT DECLARED (finding for Mark): the closed unit vocabulary has no unit for 1/s, so it cannot be declared without inventing a unit. (The two unit-inconsistent R140 scale factors that were also omitted here are gone: since R140, stream B5, the impedance scan derives its power loop from dampingMwPerHz and synInertiaMwsPerHz on the converter's rating.) synInertiaMwsPerHz, dampingMwPerHz and dcVoltageV were unit gaps until Q24 (2026-10) added MW.s/Hz, MW/Hz and V to the vocabulary; they are declared below.

deadbandHz.description: Frequency deadband of the grid-forming response (Hz).

synInertiaMwsPerHz.description: Synthetic-inertia gain of the grid-forming law p = -synInertia * df/dt - damping * (f - f0): MW per Hz/s of measured df/dt, so MW.s/Hz. It is POWER per df/dt, NOT stored energy, and is never folded into a machine H. 0 or absent = pure droop.

codeDefaults.consumer: FormingAggregate.FromFleet (frequency model Ev = sum synInertia * f0/2): absent => 0

dampingMwPerHz.description: Damping (droop) gain of the grid-forming law, MW per Hz of frequency deviation (an absolute MW/Hz, not per MW of rating). 0 or absent = no damping leg.

codeDefaults.consumer: FormingAggregate.FromFleet (frequency model Dv = sum damping): absent => 0

dispatchRampMwPerMin.description: Dispatch ramp rate (MW/min). Refused at load since R073 (October 2026): no controller has a dispatch setpoint to ramp (the inverters model the response about a fixed dispatch). The observed fleet ramp band the bundled v1 classes carried was removed from the data and is recorded in docs/technical/0013 Asset-dynamics data grounding.md.

headroomUpFraction.description: Upward response headroom as a fraction of rating.

headroomDownFraction.description: Downward response headroom as a fraction of rating.

rocofTripHzPerS.description: RoCoF trip threshold (Hz/s); absent = never trips on RoCoF.

rocofTripConfirmS.description: Definite-time confirmation delay of the RoCoF trip (s).

codeDefaults.consumer: GridFormingInverter controller: absent => AssetParamDefaults.RocofTripConfirmS, 0.5 s (EREC G99 Issue 2 Table 10.1 LoM (RoCoF) time delay; R137, B4 October 2026: one default for both inverter kinds)

localRocofUpliftFactor.description: Ratio of local RoCoF to centre-of-inertia RoCoF; 1 = no uplift.

lvrtVoltagePu.description: Low-voltage ride-through trip level (pu); 0 = never trips on voltage.

virtualReactancePu.description: Virtual (plus filter/transformer) reactance behind the EMF, pu on the unit rating. TWO DIFFERENT code defaults (inconsistency register).

codeDefaults.consumer: GridFormingImpedance placeholder when the class has none; also repeated by CliDefaults.PlaceholderGfmVirtualReactancePu
RmsConverterParameters VirtualReactancePu record default (RMS grid-forming converter)
GridFormingImpedance.FromAssetClass: absent read as 0, then replaced by the placeholder

powerLoopBandwidthHz.description: Grid-forming power-loop bandwidth (Hz), impedance scan only.

codeDefaults.consumer: GridFormingImpedance placeholder when the class has none
GridFormingImpedance.FromAssetClass: absent read as 0, then replaced by the placeholder

virtualROverX.description: Grid-forming virtual resistance as a fraction of the virtual reactance (R/X).

virtualInertiaH.description: Virtual inertia constant H of the RMS grid-forming (virtual synchronous machine) model, s on the unit rating.

rmsDampingPu.description: Damping/droop gain of the RMS grid-forming model, pu power per pu speed (20 = 5 % droop).

faultCurrentPu.description: Converter current limit / fault-current multiple k (x rated current).

capacityMwh.description: Usable energy (MWh) of the DC store behind the converter; 0 or absent = unbounded (no store). Read through DcSources.FromClass; its code defaults are recorded on the storage kind.

socInit.description: Initial state of charge (fraction of capacityMwh). Read through DcSources.FromClass; its code defaults are recorded on the storage kind.

socMin.description: Lower state-of-charge bound of the simple SoC bucket (used when no chemistry is set). Read through DcSources.FromClass; its code defaults are recorded on the storage kind.

socMax.description: Upper state-of-charge bound of the simple SoC bucket (used when no chemistry is set). Read through DcSources.FromClass; its code defaults are recorded on the storage kind.

batteryChemistry.description: Chemistry pack behind the converter. v1 stores a numeric code (0 or absent = none, 1 LFP, 2 NMC, 3 LTO, 4 Na-ion, 5 VRFB, 6 lead-acid; DcSources.ChemistryFromCode); v2 names it. No codeDefault: the v1 fallback is the numeric code 0, which is not one of these names. Read through DcSources.FromClass; its code defaults are recorded on the storage kind.

dcVoltageV.description: DC pack voltage (V) of the battery store behind the converter, used to size the series cell count. Read through DcSources.FromClass; its code defaults are recorded on the storage kind. The 1500 V ceiling is the low-voltage DC limit that utility battery packs are built to.

converterEfficiency.description: One-way converter efficiency between the chemistry pack and the grid. Read through DcSources.FromClass; its code defaults are recorded on the storage kind.

ambientC.description: Ambient temperature of the chemistry pack (degC). Read through DcSources.FromClass; its code defaults are recorded on the storage kind.
